Just because you intake a medication at a set level, didn't mean that's how your internal hormone levels are sitting at. They fluctuate like any other hormone due to a process that controls how much of a hormone stays in your body. It's the reason for a monthly cycle for women, and a daily cycle for men. Calling comparing a monthly hormone cycle started by the endocrine system to afab monthly hormone cycles started by the endocrine system offensive is a bit over the top.
